title: UnitDamageStateChanged
description: A unit moved to another damage state (CONTRACTS §6; COMBAT CB-6). A hit worsens it: one event per hit, from the state before to the state after, none when the hit destroys the unit (UnitDestroyed). Repair at a friendly base improves it, one event per tick it changes the state. Public view: dropped for a victim the viewer side does not currently observe (FOW-13).
